llmnav-catalog/1 repository=relaydock catalog=relaydock.persistence
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@relaydock.persistence.atomic-file
role Persist bounded local state through a same-directory temporary file, durable flushes, restrictive permissions, and recoverable replacement.
owns atomic file replacement, local state durability, bounded file reads
excludes state serialization, multi-process locking
invariant The previous complete file remains recoverable until the replacement is installed. Reads reject files larger than the caller limit before returning bytes.

@relaydock.persistence.migrations
role Apply or roll back embedded PostgreSQL migrations in version order under one advisory lock with checksum validation.
owns migration serialization, migration checksum ledger, transactional migration steps
excludes migration SQL definitions, database backup policy
invariant Only one runner mutates the schema while the advisory lock is held. Each migration step and its ledger update commit in the same transaction.
